note: Configuration of the Computational Space. Nothing here is a planting rule. Field methods and their accuracy are listed so that results never claim more precision than the sources have; the thresholds under `experiments` are starting values for trying the space out and every call can override them.

lattice.why: One lattice for the whole site, aligned with the USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM: a cell centre is a DEM sample point. Cells finer than the DEM are refused so the grid never suggests a precision the terrain data does not have.

field.elevation.name: Elevation
field.elevation.method: Bilinear sample of the USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM at the cell's representative point (a DEM node for whole cells).
field.elevation.toleranceBasis: 3DEP vertical accuracy is about 0.1 m: smaller differences are treated as equal.

field.slope.name: Slope
field.slope.method: Central difference of the DEM over the baseline below (2 m = ±1 m), in degrees.
field.slope.toleranceBasis: A few centimetres of relative DEM noise over a 2 m baseline is about ±1.5°: smaller slope differences are not meaningful.

field.distance-to-path.name: Distance to path
field.distance-to-path.method: Exact planar distance to the nearest path polygon (gravel walks, grass walks, sidewalks); 0 inside a path.
field.distance-to-path.toleranceBasis: Path and bed outlines from OpenStreetMap are good to about ±0.5 m.

field.distance-to-edge.name: Distance to bed edge
field.distance-to-edge.method: Exact planar distance from the point to the outline of its own bed (the planting boundary).
field.distance-to-edge.toleranceBasis: Bed outlines (steel edging, OSM) are good to about ±0.5 m.

field.distance-to-obstacle.name: Distance to wall or structure
field.distance-to-obstacle.method: Exact planar distance to the nearest object on the layers below (walls, Carillon, memorial, boardwalk, swale, benches); 0 inside one.

field.canopy.name: Existing tree crown above
field.canopy.method: 1 where the point lies under an existing tree crown digitised from NAIP imagery (circle of the crown radius), else 0. A physical obstacle, not a sun or shade measurement.
field.canopy.toleranceBasis: Crown outlines are circles fitted to aerial imagery.

field.sun.name: Sun / shade
field.sun.note: No measured or modelled insolation. Unknown, never 0.

field.moisture.name: Soil moisture
field.moisture.note: Hydrology zones are not mapped. Unknown, never 0.

hyp.low-ground-wetter.name: Hypothetical: lower ground is wetter
hyp.low-ground-wetter.note: A made-up test field for overlaying more than two conditions: 1 at the lowest point of the design beds, 0 at the highest. It is NOT soil moisture and NOT Detroit data.

experiments.note: Starting thresholds for the acceptance experiment. They are experiments, not planting rules.
